name: Takemura Makoto
source:
Early 30's she is her husband's kouhai
Takemura Toshiki's wife. Cheerful and refreshing personality.
While relationship with the husband is good, sex don't feel pleasant with the husband, honestly don't like it.
However cannot say it to the husband so creates an excuse to refuse it.
In order to de-stress runs and plays volley in the "Mama's Volley" as so to avoid accumulating libido.
Never thought of cheating but there's an big sexual side.
"I believe that running increases the stamina. I run every morning, if you like how about join me?"
